title: Scatter Chart
description: Two measures, one cloud of dots — the chart that shows whether they move together.
usage: For correlation questions: spend vs. return, price vs. rating. If the reader only needs one measure over time, that is a Line Chart; this is for two measures at once.
a11y: The figure carries the conclusion in its label ("spend and signups rise together"), because a dot cloud cannot be read point by point by ear.
